scope: Local autonomous E06 application workers, independent platform engine and external PostgreSQL/Redis workflow persistence
authorization: Local only; no dedicated server, global installation, actual owner data migration, Git mutation or remote activation

entrypoints.services: bun run jobs:services start --directory .local/jobs-services --cells cells.json --platform platform.json

configuration.GODSEYE_INNGEST_CELLS: Existing owner project/environment cells JSON; same strict six-listener shape as previous integration
configuration.GODSEYE_JOBS_PLATFORM: Independent sentinel project/environment UUIDs and six listener ports; required by executable supervisor
configuration.GODSEYE_JOBS_CONTROL_FILE: Absolute private control.json containing databaseUrl; mutually exclusive with direct GODSEYE_DATABASE_URL
configuration.GODSEYE_JOBS_STORAGE_FILE: Absolute private array of exact application plus platform PostgreSQL/Redis bindings
configuration.GODSEYE_JOBS_WORKER_MODULE: Optional absolute owner-selected first-party module exporting createWorker({scope})

implemented: Separate trusted supervisor with shared PostgreSQL owner journal and independent local + session-held database singleton ownership
Owner HTTP detached mode consumes no local.jobs work, starts no application listener/native engine and retains owner admission/UI operations
Foundation consumer adapter/environment partitions apply before queued validation and expired-lease mutation
Cell application/SDK/handler processes receive only their own settings, paths, keys and own engine storage; environment and exec arguments exclude owner/foreign authority
Strict monotonic capability IPC with independent byte/pending/actual-call bounds, safe errors and retained timeout capacity
Current Foundation lease plus backend lifecycle is checked before dispatch and again at the actual child handler boundary, including manual and cron work
Trusted application module routes, handlers and outbox senders/inspection execute only in the cell child
Remote outbox delivery is authorized against its original durable scoped claim, attempt, payload digest and current lifecycle
Durable fresh-owner-authorized reconciliation queue permits detached owner UI to request actual remote read-only probes without executing application code in HTTP

Read-only reconciliation payload acquisition and final child authorization validate their own matching reconciling lease rather than incorrectly requiring a running mutation lease; parent-bound mode cannot be selected by child, mutation checkpoint and outbox remain fenced
Dynamic per-cell bounded cron catalog rebuild and SDK PUT reconciliation; overflow refuses rather than silently truncating global overview
Separate signed platform maintenance engine and child with independent PostgreSQL, Redis and key material; no application envelope capability or second jobs dispatch calendar

External workflow bindings require both private authenticated PostgreSQL/Redis and refuse embedded fallback, duplicate/aliased stores, owner database reuse, superuser workflow roles and nonpersistent/evicting Redis
Native engine guardian owns the actual ChildProcess handle and terminates it on inherited IPC disconnect, with bounded escalation and no stale numeric PID killing
Concurrent cold PostgreSQL migrations serialize before any lock table bootstrap
Compiled supervisor/cell/platform entrypoints retain SDK runtime package assets and include guardian plus additive migrations

Prepared Compose corrected with independent PostgreSQL bootstrap material, non-superuser workflow initialization, explicit PGDATA parent volume, AOF always and Compose2.23.1 config-content requirement

preservedLimits: Existing PGlite owner journal is preserved; autonomous topology explicitly requires a selected PostgreSQL journal with existing prepared cells. No owner account/project or data migration is performed automatically.
Native first-party process/capability separation does not qualify Docker/gVisor hostile-code containment, firewall/IPv6/quota behavior or the dedicated server.
Prepared Compose remains unqualified until actual image/daemon/runtime deployment is proven; native local proof is the enabled local persistence path.

Pinned upstream engine event ingress remains in-memory even with external stores; application source intent is acknowledged only after durable Foundation receipt and redriven with stable domain identity.
Coordinated cross-service disaster recovery and release-host qualification remain broader V1 obligations, not implied by local restart tests.
